site.title: Codex
site.description: Consoulium 2026: Ayatic Codex explores the divine patterns and rhythmic order woven into the universe. By mindfully observing the manifest signs (ayat) across creation—from delicate ecosystems to majestic galaxies—we discover the clearest path to the Creator, inspiring a faith built on profound certainty.
site.themeLine: Think it, build it, ship it, scale it

chapters.title: Perceive the signs at dawn
chapters.text: Begin with careful observation. Every small detail offers a clue to the greater order.

chapters.title: Decode the patterns by noon
chapters.text: Connect ideas across disciplines and look for the patterns that bring them together.

chapters.title: Connect the matrix before dusk
chapters.text: Build a clearer picture by linking what you discover with the world around you.

chapters.title: Attain certainty by nightfall
chapters.text: Carry your learning forward with curiosity, purpose, and thoughtful action.
